comments.value:
I get this too on the Oculus version. It's not the controllers themselves, as the Oculus dash tracking is perfect, and the steamvr version of vrchat doesn't have this issue either.
I also find that the jittering seems to be a consistent amount of movement in the world space. Meaning that the smaller the avatar you use, the more noticable the jittering becomes

details:
Observed in versions: 
Build 933 to 1007

Description of bug: 
When using the PC version of VRChat that is distributed on the Oculus store, hand motion (i.e. touch controller motion) appears jittery. This issue is not observed on the SteamVR version of VRChat. On close inspection of an 80fps video recording, the jitter appears on approximately every 8th frame. (I think that means it's happening every 100ms.) On these frames, the hand positions appear extrapolated slightly. 

Steps to reproduce: 
1. Using an Oculus Rift S, launch the Oculus store version of VRChat. 
2. Launch a high-performance world that yields a solid 80fps. 
3. Move your hand around in front of your face. If you cannot perceive the jitter yet, do step 4.
4. Hold your hand out in a fixed position in front of your face. Then rotate your torso so that your head and outstretched arm move in unison. (Don't use the analog stick to rotate your view.) When your hand remains in a fixed position within your moving view, the jitter becomes obvious. 

Video demonstration: 
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3xkwgCrC0LI 
Note that this video contains 80fps footage that has been slowed down to 60fps (75% speed) for the first part and 10fps (12.5% speed) for the second part. 

Context/story:
I previously observed this jitter many months ago and it was one of the reasons why I initially chose to use the SteamVR version instead. 
At the beginning of June, Valve released an update to SteamVR (1.12.5), which felt to me like it radically degraded performance in VRChat. I decided to switch to the Oculus store version of VRChat and observed this jitter again.
For a number of reasons, I'm now actually considering sticking with the Oculus store version of VRChat, regardless of whether Valve fixes the performance issues with SteamVR. So I hope that this jitter on the Oculus store version of VRChat can be fixed.
title: Hand position jitter on Oculus version
